topic: a re-read row must re-pass the resumability policies before its resume ids are restored
lesson: recoverLostProviderSessionRetirement validates the refreshed row only on agentSessionId and the null-normalised reset_at generation, then hands back its providerSessionId and externalSessionId when restoreResumeIdentifiers is true. Those two checks establish WHICH row the turn is looking at; they do not establish that the row is resumable. The access-fingerprint match (0158 makes leaving the resumable set 'never optional' for a mismatch) and the mark-versus-cap comparison must BOTH be re-applied to the refreshed row before any resume identifier is returned, because a concurrent writer can install a session created under a different access projection or one already over the cap. Restoring unvalidated ids defeats the fingerprint rule and the ceiling at once. The orchestrator's earlier instruction — that the re-read is the current truth and so may be resumed — was wrong: it is the current truth about identity, not about eligibility.
